Metadata tags.

Minimal port of symphonia-core/src/meta.rs for Phase 2 (WAV INFO). Full StandardTag vocabulary, visuals, and reader traits arrive with the metadata phase.

Types

MetadataLog = object
  revisions*: seq[MetadataRevision]
MetadataRevision = object
  tags*: seq[Tag]
RawValue = object
  case kind*: RawValueKind
  of rvString:
    str*: string
  of rvSignedInt:
    sint*: int64
  of rvUnsignedInt:
    uint*: uint64
  of rvFloat:
    flt*: float64
  of rvBoolean:
    boolean*: bool
  of rvBinary:
    binary*: seq[uint8]
RawValueKind = enum
  rvString, rvSignedInt, rvUnsignedInt, rvFloat, rvBoolean, rvBinary
Tag = object
  key*: string
  stdKey*: Option[string]
  value*: RawValue
key is the native key (INAM, TIT2, ...), stdKey the normalized name when known (track_title, artist, ...).
